articles.summary: American fashion designer and film director Mr. Tom Ford and Dr. Dune Ives, CEO of Lonely Whale, today revealed the finalists for the TOM FORD Plastic Innovation Prize, the only global competition focused exclusively on creating scalable and biologically degradable alternatives to thin-film plastic polybags. “What we accomplish together through…
articles.title: TOM FORD Plastic Innovation Prize Announces Finalists for Thin-Film Plastic Alternatives Competition
